passages.text: The technology club tests a small toy car in the school hall. Nora holds the remote control and checks which buttons make the car move. Her partner stands behind her and asks her to turn around before he explains the route. They agree to keep the car away from the chairs so that there is enough space. On the first try, Nora presses the wrong button, so they stop and look at the labels together. After a second careful try, the car follows the route, and the partners record which buttons they used.

parallelText.en: The technology club tests a small toy car in the school hall.
parallelText.zh: 科技俱乐部在学校大厅测试一辆小玩具车。

parallelText.en: Nora holds the remote control and checks which buttons make the car move.
parallelText.zh: 诺拉拿着遥控器，检查哪些按钮能让小车移动。

parallelText.en: Her partner stands behind her and asks her to turn around before he explains the route.
parallelText.zh: 搭档站在她身后，请她先转身，再向她说明路线。

parallelText.en: They agree to keep the car away from the chairs so that there is enough space.
parallelText.zh: 他们约定让小车远离椅子，留出足够空间。

parallelText.en: On the first try, Nora presses the wrong button, so they stop and look at the labels together.
parallelText.zh: 第一次尝试时，诺拉按错了按钮，于是他们停下来，一起看标签。

parallelText.en: After a second careful try, the car follows the route, and the partners record which buttons they used.
parallelText.zh: 第二次仔细尝试后，小车沿着路线行驶，两位搭档记下所使用的按钮。

passages.text: Our class takes a small lamp on a daytime trip to the school garden. The lamp uses solar power, so we put its panel where it can receive sunlight. Leo asks the teacher whether he may help choose the place for it. “Of course,” she says, and asks him to explain why one place is better than another. He notices that a tree shades one corner, so he chooses an open spot instead. The pupils draw both places in their notebooks and write why the open spot is better for the lamp.

parallelText.en: Our class takes a small lamp on a daytime trip to the school garden.
parallelText.zh: 我们班白天去学校花园时带了一盏小灯。

parallelText.en: The lamp uses solar power, so we put its panel where it can receive sunlight.
parallelText.zh: 这盏灯使用太阳能，所以我们把面板放在能接收到阳光的地方。

parallelText.en: Leo asks the teacher whether he may help choose the place for it.
parallelText.zh: 利奥问老师，自己能不能帮忙选择放置地点。

parallelText.en: “Of course,” she says, and asks him to explain why one place is better than another.
parallelText.zh: “当然可以，”老师说，并请他说明为什么一个位置比另一个更好。

parallelText.en: He notices that a tree shades one corner, so he chooses an open spot instead.
parallelText.zh: 他发现一棵树给一个角落遮了阴，所以改选一块开阔的地方。

parallelText.en: The pupils draw both places in their notebooks and write why the open spot is better for the lamp.
parallelText.zh: 学生们在笔记本里画出两个位置，并写下开阔处为什么更适合放这盏灯。
